occurrenceRemarks: Description: Hard white on the outside and brown-grey on the inside organisms found on the tree's bark. The size is about 0.5 inches. Grow together in communes. The tree where these fungi grow is located on the alley in the center of Almaty city. a website with family description: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schizophyllaceae

this species from the genus Picea is a plant that grows vertically from the soil and is approximately 15 meters tall. It has a hard woody stem approximately 1 m in circumference covered with dark brown bark. Many branches form the tree crown which covers the stem entirely. Branches have the same bark as the stem. The crown has a conical shape. The branches are almost entirely covered in green elongated needles. There are a lot of them on each branch. Needles are quite soft and about 2 cm long. Newer needles are softer and lighter. This particular tree was found in mountain mixed forest terrain and there are many same species organisms around it. To be specific, it is the Ile-Alatau National Park located near Almaty. The climate here is temperate and quite dry with big temperature differences throughout the year. Spruces are typically "found in the northern temperate and boreal (taiga) regions of the Eart." They tend to grow on mountains and plains. Do not tend to form forests but grow in groups. Reference article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spruce

This species from the genus Pinus is a plant that grows vertically from the soil and is approximately 20 meters tall. It has a hard woody stem approximately 1 m in circumference covered with dark brown bark. Many branches form the tree crown which has layers of branches. The distance between layers is about 1-1.5 m. Branches have the same bark as the stem. The smaller branches are covered in green elongated needles. There are a lot of them on each branch. Needles are quite soft and about 3 cm long. Cones or strobili were found on the ground near the tree. They are about 3 cm long and have a light brown color. This particular tree was found in mountain mixed forest terrain and there are many same species organisms around it. To be specific, it is the Ile-Alatau National Park located near Almaty. The climate here is temperate and quite dry with big temperature differences throughout the year. "Pines are native to the Northern Hemisphere, and in a few parts of the tropics in the Southern Hemisphere." "Pines may be found in a very large variety of environments, ranging from semi-arid desert to rainforests, from sea level up to 5,200 metres (17,100 ft), from the coldest to the hottest environments on Earth. They often occur in mountainous areas with favorable soils and at least some water." Reference article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pine

This species from the genus Betula is a plant that grows vertically from the soil and is approximately 15 meters tall. It has a hard woody stem approximately 1 m in circumference covered in white smooth bark which is very inconsistent, and dark rough bark can be seen in some places. Many branches form the tree crown in the shape of the candle flame. Large branches have the same bark as the stem, but smaller ones are just covered in thin smooth dark brown bark. There is evidence that the tree has leaves, but in this observation, there aren't many of them and they are dry. Leaves have networks of veins, are smooth and shaped as a rounded triangle with serrated edges. This particular tree was found in mountain mixed forest terrain and there are many same species organisms around it. To be specific, it is the Ile-Alatau National Park located near Almaty. The climate here is temperate and quite dry with big temperature differences throughout the year. Overall, the genus of Birches is "widespread in the Northern Hemisphere, particularly in northern areas of temperate climates and in boreal climates." Birches are common in Europe, Asia, and North America. Common habitats are deciduous and mixed forests. Reference article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birch
